subject: Fiscal Year 2017 Property Tax Rate
overview: The Medford City Council held its annual tax classification hearing, approving the minimum residential factor and declining residential and small commercial exemptions. The council also authorized a loan order and grant acceptance for the Riverside Plaza renovation project.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2017 Property Tax Classification Hearing
items.summary: The council approved the minimum residential factor of 0.903265, voted against adopting an open space discount, residential exemption, and small commercial exemption, and defeated a motion to reduce the tax levy by $500,000.

items.title: Riverside Plaza Renovation Grant and Loan Order
items.summary: The council approved on first reading a $550,000 loan order and grant acceptance of $250,000 from the Land and Water Conservation Fund for Riverside Plaza improvements, while requesting an explanation of funding plans for a proposed police station.

items.title: Special Permit for Pet Store at Meadow Glen Mall
items.summary: The council approved a special permit for Medford Associates LLC to operate a Petco retail store without overnight boarding or the retail sale of dogs and cats at 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Class 2 Auto Dealers License for Inman Motor Corp
items.summary: Approved a Class 2 auto dealer license for Inman Motor Corp for 157 cars at 357 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Grant of Location for Underground Conduit at 630 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Removed from the table and approved a grant of location petition from National Grid and Verizon for underground conduit work on Boston Avenue.

items.title: Resolution Regarding Langwood Commons Development
items.summary: Adopted an amended resolution requesting the administration, state agencies, and conservation groups provide data on traffic and pedestrian safety impacts from the Langwood Commons project.

items.title: Resolution Regarding Street Tree Planting and Sidewalk Damage
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a report from the city arborist and DPW regarding tree species, sidewalk repairs, tree plantings, and stump removals.

items.title: Resolution on Municipal Reserve and Stabilization Policy
items.summary: Referred a resolution requesting the establishment of a formal policy and funding schedule for the municipal stabilization reserve fund to the mayor.

items.title: Public Petitions and Communications
items.summary: Heard a citizen petition regarding police department staffing diversity and a critique of the mayor's conversations initiative.

items.title: Holiday Recycling Pickup and Meeting Cancellation
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting increased weekly recycling pickup during the holiday season and canceling the regular council meeting scheduled for December 27, 2016.
